build: Release, C++17, -O2 -DNDEBUG, exceptions and RTTI enabled for both libraries
source_hash_method: SHA256 over sorted CMakeLists.txt, benchmarks/compare_benchmark.cpp, include/**/*.h, src/**/*.h and src/**/*.cpp: relative_path + NUL + bytes + NUL
threading: 1 foreground thread; each engine retains its background compaction implementation
read_cache_state: fresh engine/cache per workload, one full identical workload warmup before measurement; OS cache not cleared
configuration_order: round1 off/on, round2 on/off, alternating through round5
engine_order: alternates by actual round and dataset size; 5 MapleDB-first and 5 LevelDB-first pairs per Bloom setting
db_directories: unique temporary parent; exact paths and invocations in execution.json
